description: Self-contained on purpose: this tree is public, so no private preset references.
An UPSTREAM_REF bump is a release event for the overlay: CI reassembles from the new tag or commit and the pipeline verdict says exactly what broke. Review, never automerge.
NuGet pins live inside patches/ where no manager reaches them; the cache library pin has a compatibility ceiling documented in DIVERGENCE.md that a bot cannot know.
